339-677-6495-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-677-6495-8201.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

549-1315-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-1315-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.
549-1315-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

687-2034-7704-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-2034-7704-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Doc Samson), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Doc Samson.
Repeat.
687-2034-7704-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

2105-5223-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

277-851-3129-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-851-3129-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3413-3967-4875.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2946-3967-4871-4976.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4871-4976.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-7730.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-7692.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2049-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-5434.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1477-1494-4840-5131.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1477-1494-4840-5131.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Extruder five times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4390-5078-6289-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6289-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

3197-4050-7363.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-4050-7363.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 2.

5256-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7236.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Towering Titan.
When Towering Titan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1765-5231-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-5231-5972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2719-3963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2719-3963-7009.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2719-3963-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

877-4254-6845.description:
Cast Spider-Byte by paying {0}.
When Spider-Byte enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

437-2757-3525.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Sphinx's Disciple, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2685-2919-3197-4321.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-2919-3197-4321.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2604-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3499-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

618-1418-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the first champion trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the second champion trigger, exiling the Lightning Crafter token.
When the Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

527-542-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

575-4465-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-4465-5971.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Basal Sliver dies, Yedora triggers, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Basal Sliver enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basal Sliver by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Basal Sliver face-up.
Repeat.

2440-2534-4183-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter
2440-2534-4183-4758.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Coercive Recruiter for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

804-5226-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
804-5226-5365.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.
804-5226-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1692-2921-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-2921-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-2921-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

579-654-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
579-654-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
579-654-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

509-1912-4131.notablePrerequisites: Idris does not have summoning sickness.
509-1912-4131.description:
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2837-3259-4076.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2837-3259-4076.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Burakos as attackers.
Burakos triggers, causing the defending player to lose at least 1 life and you to create at least one 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If you have two or more creatures in your party, you will create infinite Cat tokens, and then you may instead make Dog tokens using Jinnie Fay or Treasure tokens.

1424-2534-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
1424-2534-4875.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

877-1224-4254.description:
Cast Psychic Pickpocket by paying {0}.
When Psychic Pickpocket enters, it triggers, causing it to connive and return itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

481-1173-2160.manaNeeded: {R}{R} the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} available each extra turn
481-1173-2160.notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
481-1173-2160.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying {R}{R}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Final Fortune from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn and exiling the Final Fortune trigger from the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

190-953-1371-4435.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting Alhammarret's Archive.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Fractured Identity.
Resolve each opponent's Fractured Identity.
Resolve your Fractured Identity, exiling Alhammarret's Archive and causing each opponent to create a copy of it.
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw cards equal to twice their deck size, and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
Repeat step 7 for each other opponent.

1056-1719-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
You have at least one additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
1056-1719-4639.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling another card from your graveyard for each opponent you have, giving Vizier of Tumbling Sands encore until end of turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' encore ability by paying {2}{U} and exiling it, creating at least two token copies of it with haste.
Activate a Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, targeting another Vizier of Tumbling Sands token.
The Vizier of Tumbling Sands token triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token.
Repeat from step 3.

1335-2313-2440.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2313-2440.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may repeat step 3 to give Marath infinite +1/+1 counters, then use them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
You may also use Marath's abilities to put infinite +1/+1 counters on Conclave Mentor, then kill it to gain infinite life.

1409-2767-3518.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Leonin Squire.
1409-2767-3518.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Leonin Squire by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Leonin Squire enters the battlefield triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator.
Resolve the Leonin Squire trigger, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it with Leonin Squire.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat.

190-588-2607-2765.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least twenty one.
190-588-2607-2765.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Illusions of Grandeur and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
The nontoken Illusions of Grandeur's second ability triggers, and each token Illusions of Grandeur's first ability triggers.
Resolve each token Illusions of Gradeur's trigger, causing each opponent to gain no life due to Archfiend of Despair.
Resolve the nontoken Illusions of Grandeur's trigger, causing you to lose twenty life.
Cast Aether Snap by paying {3}{B}{B}, removing all counters from all permanents and exiling all tokens.
Each opponent's Illusions of Grandeur leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose twenty life.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.

269-1494-3978.notablePrerequisites: Sage of Hours has the lowest toughness or is tied for the lowest toughness among creatures you control.
269-1494-3978.description:
Cast Sandsteppe Mastodon by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Sandsteppe Mastodon enters the battlefield, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the begging of your upkeep, Species Gorger triggers, causing you to return Sandsteppe Mastodon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

65-615-717-2628-4371.description:
Activate Irrigated Farmland's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Irrigated Farmland, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Irrigated Farmland trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Cartographer.
Cartographer enters the battlefield, returning Irrigated Farmland from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
